items.title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
items.content: Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 苹果新任CEO约翰·特纳斯将在9月9日首次重大产品发布会上推出可折叠iPhone。据彭博报道，彭博智能硬件分析师吴振浩认为，特纳斯的工程背景将有助于苹果硬件发展，并扩展其生态系统，因智能手机升级趋于渐进。
summaries.en: Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, is set to launch a foldable iPhone at an event on September 9. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Woo Jin Ho notes that Ternus' engineering background may refocus on hardware and expand Apple's ecosystem amid incremental smartphone upgrades. The foldable iPhone is expected to be a key highlight of the event.

items.title: TCS Plans One-Gigawatt Capacity Data Center in Southern India
items.content: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.
items.contentSnippet: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.
items.creator: Ashutosh Joshi

summaries.zh: 塔塔咨询服务公司（TCS）及其HyperVault部门与合作伙伴承诺投资700亿卢比（约74亿美元），在南印度建设一个大规模人工智能数据中心园区。此举旨在加速该公司在该地区的发展，该地区已成为印度科技企业优先考虑的未来增长区域。
summaries.en: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and its HyperVault partners are investing $7.4 billion to build a one-gigawatt AI data center campus in southern India. The project aims to accelerate TCS's expansion into a region prioritized for growth by Indian tech firms. The commitment reflects the company's focus on scaling its data center capabilities in the area.

items.title: Abu Dhabi’s G42 Weighs US Ownership to Safeguard AI Chip Access
items.content: Executives at Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence firm G42 have held exploratory talks over potentially selling a majority stake to American companies, people familiar with the matter said, as it races to guarantee access to high-tech chips beyond next year.
items.contentSnippet: Executives at Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence firm G42 have held exploratory talks over potentially selling a majority stake to American companies, people familiar with the matter said, as it races to guarantee access to high-tech chips beyond next year.
items.creator: Alex Dooler, Zainab Fattah and Dinesh Nair

summaries.zh: 阿布扎比人工智能公司G42正与美国公司探讨出售多数股权，以保障明年之后的高科技芯片供应。知情人士透露，该公司正在积极寻求解决方案，以确保持续获得先进AI芯片。此举旨在确保其人工智能业务的持续发展。
summaries.en: G42, an Abu Dhabi-based AI firm, is exploring the sale of a majority stake to US companies to secure access to advanced AI chips beyond 2024. Executives have held talks with American firms as part of efforts to ensure continued access to high-tech hardware. The move aims to mitigate potential supply disruptions and maintain G42's operations in the competitive AI landscape.

items.title: China’s 26% Earnings Boom Lands With a Thud in the Stock Market
items.content: China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.
items.contentSnippet: China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.
items.creator: Bloomberg News

summaries.zh: 中国五年来利润增长达26%，但未能提振股市，因经济疲软和对AI回报的疑虑削弱了投资者信心。
summaries.en: China reported a 26% rise in corporate earnings, its best performance in five years, but the stock market failed to rally. Weak economic conditions and skepticism about the returns of AI investments dampened investor sentiment. The strong earnings growth was not enough to offset broader market concerns.

items.title: Ayako Yoshioka Discusses Tech’s Impact on Inflation and Prices
items.content: Ayako Yoshioka, a Senior Investment Strategist at Wealth Enhancement Group, joins the show to discuss technology’s role in the inflation outlook. The segment frames a client conversation around whether technology could help stoke inflation in the near term or, alternatively, contribute to lower prices and cost relief for the broader economy over time. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.content: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. items.title: Diane Swonk Says August Jobs Report Shows Mixed but Strong Labor Market Signals
items.content: Diane Swonk, Chief Economist at KPMG, discusses the August jobs report, which showed U.S. payrolls rising by 162,000, above expectations, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%. The segment also notes revisions to prior figures and points out that the data contain a lot of noise. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Jay Chaudhry Says AI Is Driving More Demand for Cybersecurity at Zscaler
items.content: Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry said AI is creating a major tailwind for the cybersecurity industry rather than reducing the need for software security. He argued that CEOs, CIOs, and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but are worried that new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches, or cause applications to be hacked or hijacked. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry said AI is creating a major tailwind for the cybersecurity industry rather than reducing the need for software security. He argued that CEOs, CIOs, and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but are worried that new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches, or cause applications to be hacked or hijacked. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Zscaler首席执行官Jay Chaudhry表示，人工智能正推动网络安全需求增长，而非减少软件安全需求。他认为，企业高管希望通过AI提升生产力和降低成本，但担心新AI模型可能引发漏洞、导致数据泄露或被黑客攻击。此观点源自Bloomberg对Jay Chaudhry的采访。
summaries.en: Jay Chaudhry, CEO of Zscaler, stated that AI is boosting demand for cybersecurity rather than diminishing it. He explained that while CEOs and boards seek AI for productivity and cost savings, they are concerned about AI models causing vulnerabilities, breaches, or application hijacking. These worries are driving increased demand for cybersecurity solutions. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: What Adam Smith Would Say of Bond Market Turmoil (Video)

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《亚当·斯密会如何评论债券市场动荡（视频）》

文章内容摘要：本文通过视频探讨亚当·斯密的经济理论视角，分析其对当前债券市场动荡的看法。文章指出，斯密强调市场自由与供需关系，认为动荡源于政策干预或投机行为。视频结合历史案例，阐述斯密观点对现代市场的启示，呼吁回归市场基本原理以稳定市场。内容客观呈现斯密理论的应用，未涉及具体市场数据或预测。
summaries.en: The article discusses Adam Smith's economic theories and how they might apply to current bond market turmoil. It highlights Smith's emphasis on free markets and self-interest, suggesting these principles could offer insights into the recent market instability. The video likely explores how Smith's ideas relate to investor behavior and market dynamics. The piece aims to connect classical economic thought with modern financial challenges, providing a historical perspective on contemporary issues.

items.title: What Is AGI? OpenAI, Anthropic Race for Artificial General Intelligence
items.content: AI companies are in a race to create artificial general intelligence, seeing it as the catalyst for an “intelligence explosion” that reshapes the economy and society. If only they could agree on what AGI would actually look like, and how it might be achieved
items.contentSnippet: AI companies are in a race to create artificial general intelligence, seeing it as the catalyst for an “intelligence explosion” that reshapes the economy and society. If only they could agree on what AGI would actually look like, and how it might be achieved

summaries.zh: 人工智能公司正竞相研发通用人工智能（AGI），视其为引发“智能爆炸”的关键，将重塑经济与社会。然而，业界对于AGI的具体形态及实现路径尚未达成共识。
summaries.en: AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are competing to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI), which they view as a potential "intelligence explosion" capable of transforming the economy and society. However, there is no consensus on what AGI would entail or how to achieve it.

items.title: Anthropic Builds Its War Chest Ahead of IPO | Bloomberg Tech 9/04/2026
items.content: Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo takes a look at Anthropic as it finalizes an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion before its anticipated public filing. Plus, a look at the latest US jobs report showing the IT sector shed 23,000 jobs in August; and Apple is kicking off the John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new devices in its history. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: OpenAI Rolls Out Its Most Advanced Model Yet
items.content: OpenAI is rolling out its most advanced model yet, with GPT-6 Astra being positioned as a major step toward AGI - but its powerful cybersecurity capabilities are also forcing OpenAI to put new guardrails in place. Bloomberg's Seth Fiegerman joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI is rolling out its most advanced model yet, with GPT-6 Astra being positioned as a major step toward AGI - but its powerful cybersecurity capabilities are also forcing OpenAI to put new guardrails in place. Bloomberg's Seth Fiegerman joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: OpenAI发布了其最新、最先进的模型GPT-6 Astra，该模型被视为迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的重要一步。然而，其强大的网络安全能力也迫使OpenAI建立新的安全防护措施。据彭博报道，彭博科技节目《Bloomberg Tech》邀请了彭博的Seth Fiegerman进行讨论。
summaries.en: OpenAI has released its most advanced model, GPT-6 Astra, marking a significant step toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). However, the model's powerful cybersecurity features have prompted OpenAI to implement new safety measures. Bloomberg's Seth Fiegerman discussed these developments with Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
